data.gender_notes: Mridani is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mridani is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘mridan’, which means ‘to delight’, ‘to charm’. This name is associated with the goddess of love, Saraswati, and symbolizes the joy and love that comes from within. It is believed to bring happiness, joy, and prosperity. The name Mridani carries the meaning “Love, Delight, Charm” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mridani usually hope their child will grow to embody love, delight, charm and live with faith, good character and purpose.
